_manual: GUI import example for FormatVersion 3: separate TX and RX Check steps. Commands and patterns are illustrative; replace them with the actual device protocol before running. Import never sends.

TX uses Kind=Tx and nonempty CommandText. RX Check uses Kind=RxCheck, empty CommandText, and RxPattern. DelayAfterMs is the whole RX check window, even after an early match; a miss does not branch or retry.
RX TxMode=null inherits the preceding enabled TX mode within the same repeat. Terminal patterns are literal and case-sensitive. HEX ?? matches one byte; at least one fixed byte is required.
RX Check observes original bytes received since the preceding TX in the same repeat and connection, including fast responses during the TX delay.

CLI/MCP cannot get, execute or overwrite this RX Check definition. Do not pass this PascalCase GUI import file to sequence save or serial_sequence_save. Existing TX-only automation uses its separate lowercase schema and CaptureMs/Expect fields.
